name: report: a standalone page the agent creates is not empty
description: Tier 2, live Galaxy. A page created without a content format is stored as html, and Galaxy then returns no content_editor for it -- so the page opens empty in the editor even though the text was accepted. History-attached notebooks default to markdown and hide this, so the record scenario does not reach it; only a standalone report does.
inputs: Create a new standalone Galaxy page titled 'Session Report' with the slug olite-report-probe. Its content should be a short markdown summary containing the marker SESSION-SUMMARY and a '## Findings' heading.
